title: This week (default)
note: ₹4,400 more sales + ₹2,300 less spending = ₹6,700 more profit. The three numbers always add up.
range: Mon 12 – Fri 16 Oct, compared with the same days last week
verdict: You sold more and spent less. Well done.

title: Today vs last Friday
note: Today compares with the same weekday last week, up to the same time, because Fridays and Tuesdays trade differently.
range: Fri 16 Oct so far, compared with last Friday
verdict: Same sales as last Friday, but you spent less.

title: This month vs same dates
note: 1–16 Oct against 1–16 Sep, never against the whole of September.
verdict: Sales grew faster than your spending.

title: Not enough history yet
note: No comparison against an empty week. The date tells the user when it starts.
verdict: You kept ₹17 of every ₹100 you sold.

title: Loss week
note: Card stays blue so it informs rather than alarms. The word Loss and the red pills carry the meaning.
range: Mon 12 – Fri 16 Oct, compared with the same days last week
verdict: You spent ₹3,100 more than you made this week. Tap to see why.

title: Loss today
note: Matches Home card F2 and the loss-day Profit page: ₹20,000 sales − ₹22,400 expenses = Loss ₹2,400.
range: Fri 16 Oct so far, compared with last Friday
verdict: You spent ₹2,400 more than you made today, mostly on stock.

title: Sold more, spent even more
note: Both rows went up; the verdict points at costs because they grew faster.
range: Mon 12 – Fri 16 Oct, compared with the same days last week
verdict: You sold more, but spending grew faster. Check your costs.

title: Payments to review
note: Unreviewed money lowers accuracy, so profit shows ≈ and the to-do line turns amber.
range: Mon 12 – Fri 16 Oct, compared with the same days last week
verdict: You sold more and spent less. Well done.

title: Days missing this week
note: The period line says which days are missing; comparison waits until they are recorded.
range: From 3 of 5 days: Mon 12 and Tue 13 not recorded
verdict: Record Monday and Tuesday to see how this week compares.

title: Up to date, nothing to do
note: With nothing to fix, the to-do line reassures instead of disappearing.
range: Mon 12 – Fri 16 Oct, compared with the same days last week
verdict: You sold more and spent less. Well done.

title: Today, early days
note: M3: Today chip, compared with yesterday.
range: Fri 16 Oct so far, compared with yesterday
verdict: Sales grew faster than your spending.

title: This month, no comparison yet
note: M5: month comparison starts next month.
verdict: You kept ₹17 of every ₹100 you sold this month.

title: Not set up
note: No masking: the card is the setup prompt, using money the user already received.
setupText: You received ₹3,42,000 this week. See how much of it is profit. It takes 2 minutes.
setupNote: Uses the payments already in your account

title: Setup started
note: Shows progress and returns the user to the exact step they left.
setupText: Finish setting up to see your profit for this week.

title: Welcome back
note: Lapsed for 7+ days: one clear action, last profit shown small so it isn't mistaken for this week's.
setupText: 214 payments came in and went out since Wed 2 Sep. Catch up to see this week's profit.
setupNote: Last recorded profit: ₹9,800 on Wed 2 Sep
